From 5f7859c1cfaeeb1677075a72e36a0f0e8b05e9a8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Bj=C3=B6rn=20T=C3=B6pel?= <bjorn.topel@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2020 23:00:05 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Documentation/features: Correct RISC-V kprobes support entry
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt incorrectly
states that RISC-V has kprobes support. This is not the case.

Note that entries that have been incorrectly marked with 'ok' will not
be changed back to 'TODO' by the features-refresh.sh script.

Fixes: 7156fc292850 ("Documentation/features: Refresh the arch support status files in place")
Signed-off-by: Björn Töpel <bjorn.topel@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200523210005.59140-1-bjorn.topel@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>

diff --git a/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt b/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt
index caa444a2a89f..8b316c6e03d4 100644
--- a/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt
+++ b/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt
@@ -23,7 +23,7 @@
     |    openrisc: | TODO |
     |      parisc: |  ok  |
     |     powerpc: |  ok  |
-    |       riscv: |  ok  |
+    |       riscv: | TODO |
     |        s390: |  ok  |
     |          sh: |  ok  |
     |       sparc: |  ok  |
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File Modified**: `Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt`
   - **Change Made**: The entry for RISC-V was changed from `ok` to `TODO`. This indicates that RISC-V does not support kprobes, correcting the previous documentation that incorrectly stated it did.

### Relationships

- The modification in `arch-support.txt` directly addresses a documentation error related to RISC-V kprobes support. The change clarifies the status of RISC-V in the context of kprobes, ensuring that the documentation accurately reflects the current capabilities of the architecture. This fix is linked to a previous commit (7156fc292850) that refreshed the architecture support status files, which inadvertently marked RISC-V as having kprobes support.

Note that entries that have been incorrectly marked with 'ok' will not
be changed back to 'TODO' by the features-refresh.sh script.

Fixes: 7156fc292850 ("Documentation/features: Refresh the arch support status files in place")
Signed-off-by: Björn Töpel <bjorn.topel@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200523210005.59140-1-bjorn.topel@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug was an incorrect entry in the documentation file `arch-support.txt`, which mistakenly indicated that RISC-V architecture has kprobes support by marking it as `ok`. This misrepresentation was likely a result of a previous automated refresh process that did not accurately reflect the actual support status of RISC-V for kprobes.
